findings.evidence: PR lines 47-49 and 70-71 use `h_le : ∀ n, 𝔽 n ≤ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω)` and `Filtration ℕ (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω)`, while Mathlib/Probability/Process/Filtration.lean:50 defines `Filtration ... (m : MeasurableSpace Ω)` and Mathlib/Probability/Martingale/Basic.lean:48-49 uses `{m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} ... {ℱ : Filtration ι m0}`.
findings.fix: Generalize to `{m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω}` with `h_le : ∀ n, 𝔽 n ≤ m0` and return `Filtration ℕ m0`; update `revFiltration_apply` accordingly.
findings.issue: `revFiltration` and its simp lemma fix the ambient space to `(inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω)`, so they cannot build a reversed `Filtration ℕ m0` over an arbitrary ambient measurable space as Mathlib APIs do.

findings.evidence: PR lines 37 and 58-65 use `[MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}`; Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/ConditionalExpectation/Basic.lean:102 has `condExp (μ : Measure[m₀] α)`, and Mathlib/Probability/Martingale/Basic.lean:141-142 states `martingale_condExp ... (ℱ : Filtration ι m0) (μ : Measure Ω)` under `{m0}`.
findings.fix: State it with `{m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : Measure[m0] Ω}` so it matches `condExp`/`martingale_condExp` and composes with the generalized `revFiltration`.
findings.issue: `revCondExpFinite` is likewise tied to the typeclass-measurable `μ : Measure Ω`, below the natural conditional-expectation signature over `Measure[m0] Ω`.

summary: The new declarations are still specialized to the typeclass measurable space, below the natural Mathlib level for filtrations and conditional expectation.
